must_read.title: Targeting tankyrase scaffolding in the β-catenin destruction complex by PROTAC overcomes the limitation of catalytic inhibitors in colorectal cancer
must_read.title_zh: 通过PROTAC靶向破坏复合体中tankyrase的支架功能，克服催化抑制剂在结直肠癌中的局限性
must_read.domain: 生物材料表面/降解产物如…
must_read.one_line: PROTAC降解tankyrase避免AXIN凝聚成点，更深抑制WNT/β-catenin，克服催化抑制剂局限。
must_read.so_what: 你q4关注材料'编程'免疫反应——PROTAC如何调控DC刚性是β-catenin骨结合下游可借鉴…
must_read.caution: CRC模型，β-catenin失活APC突变背景，骨组织微环境未验证。
must_read.abstract: Aberrant WNT/β-catenin signaling drives tumorigenesis and metastasis in cancer. Although enzymatic inhibitors of tankyrase (TNKS) effectively block AXIN degradation and stabilize the β-catenin destruction complex (DC), they have demonstrated limited efficacy in various colorectal cancer (CRC) models. Here, we demonstrate that, unexpectedly, the induction of AXIN puncta represents a major barrier to achieving therapeutic efficacy. Mechanistically, catalytic inhibition of TNKS prevents TNKS turnover and drives its accumulation in the DC, wherein the scaffolding function of TNKS induces AXIN puncta formation, rigidifies the DC, and impedes β-catenin turnover. Chemically induced degradation of TNKS overcomes this limitation by stabilizing AXIN without puncta formation, providing a deeper suppression of the WNT/β-catenin pathway activity and the proliferation of CRC cells harboring dysfunctional APC mutations. Collectively, these findings provide an explanation for the unsatisfactory outcomes of drugging the WNT/β-catenin signaling pathway by TNKS inhibitors and highlight TNKS degradation as a promising approach to treat WNT/β-catenin-driven CRC.

findings.evidence: 摘要未说明具体效应量，比较方向：PROTAC降解组 vs 催化抑制组，WNT/β-catenin活性更低，APC突变CRC细胞增殖抑制更深

deep.effect: 未报告具体效应量与置信区间
deep.relation: 与 q5 相关：提供新解释——WNT/β-catenin驱动肿瘤的治疗抵抗可通过从'催化抑制'转向'蛋白降解'策略突破；同时与 q4 间接相关，材料/分子如何'编程'信号通路命运。
deep.why: 推翻了一个长期假设：'抑制酶活性=阻断其全部功能'。TNKS的双重身份（酶+支架）在此被明确解耦——催化抑制反而因蛋白积累而保留了支架功能，PROTAC才是真正'去功能化'。这对靶向蛋白-蛋白相互作用或支架功能的课题设计有直接方法论启示。
limitations: 摘要未说明体内疗效数据（动物模型PDX或基因工程小鼠），转化价值存疑
PROTAC的脱靶降解风险、药代动力学、体内暴露均未提及
仅聚焦APC突变背景，WNT通路其他激活方式（CTNNB1突变等）是否同样受益未知
deep.transferable: ① PROTAC设计逻辑可迁移至其他'催化抑制疗效不佳'的靶点；② '蛋白积累保留支架功能'这一机制警示：酶抑制剂未必等于功能抑制剂，设计实验时需检测蛋白稳定性而非仅测活性；③ AXIN puncta作为生物标志物或药效终点值得借鉴。
followups: PROTAC降解TNKS后的体内疗效数据在哪？是否有PDX或原位模型的TGI（肿瘤生长抑制）数据？
催化抑制剂导致TNKS积累的具体半衰期延长了多少？有无pulse-chase或cycloheximide chase数据？
AXIN puncta是否在其他WNT驱动肿瘤（如口腔鳞癌、胃癌）中存在？能否作为预测因子？

must_reads.title: IFNAR1 stabilization sustains CD8+ T cell persistence in IFN-high colorectal cancer liver metastases
must_reads.title_zh: IFNAR1稳定化维持IFN-high结直肠癌肝转移中CD8+ T细胞的持久性
must_reads.one_line: 肠癌肝转移中IFN-high微环境导致CD8+T细胞IFNAR1内化损耗，稳定IFNAR1可恢复免疫治疗应答。
must_reads.so_what: q5核心参考：IFN信号与T细胞耗竭机制可直接迁移至OSCC免疫微环境研究
must_reads.caution: 肠癌转移灶机制未必直接适用于头颈鳞癌，需验证
must_reads.abstract: Colorectal cancer liver metastases (CRC-LMs) are associated with poor survival and frequently resist immunotherapy, yet the mechanisms underlying this immune refractoriness remain incompletely defined. Here, we identify a tumor-intrinsic type I interferon (IFN-I)-high state in CRC-LMs associated with loss of the IFN-α/β receptor subunit 1 (IFNAR1) on effector T lymphocytes within immune-enriched perimetastatic niches. Reduced IFNAR1 expression stratifies patients with poor clinical outcomes. Transcriptional profiling of patient-derived organoids and complementary preclinical models revealed heterogeneous but recurrent tumor-derived IFN-I production in CRC-LMs. In IFN-Ihigh contexts, sustained signaling promoted IFNAR1 internalization on effector CD8+ T cells, impairing their persistence, survival, and effector function. Pharmacologic or genetic stabilization of IFNAR1 on cell surface restored CD8+ T cell fitness and selectively enhanced T cell receptor- and chimeric antigen receptor-based immunotherapies in IFN-Ihigh tumors. These findings define a context-dependent IFN-Ihigh / IFNAR1low axis that constrains antitumor immunity in CRC-LMs and identify IFNAR1 stabilization as a strategy to convert chronic IFN signaling from a suppressive barrier into a therapeutic vulnerability.
